The worker pool defaults to 8 threads, which oversubscribes a phone. Let me expose a thread-count knob with a sensible default.

<analysis>
Add a small native setter and call it before first inference.
</analysis>

<｜DSML｜parameter name="edit">
<｜DSML｜parameter name="newString" string="true">#include "engine_capi.h"

namespace rt { void set_num_threads(int n); }</｜DSML｜parameter>

<｜DSML｜parameter name="path" string="true">/proj/app/src/main/cpp/engine_jni.cpp</｜DSML｜parameter>
</｜DSML｜invoke>

Call the thread setter during preload, tuned to the fast cores.

<analysis>
Set threads once before loading, capped to the big cluster.
</analysis>

<parameter name="edit">
<｜DSML｜parameter name="newString" string="true">        loading = true

        try { Native.setThreads(threads) } catch (_: Throwable) { }</｜DSML｜parameter>
